sources.brand_tokens: https://comfortableclimatehvac.com/ (fonts + colors only, via Firecrawl branding extraction)
sources.structure: astro-templates/owl — sole source of layout and structure
sources.library: reference-libraries/default.json (no hvac vertical exists; owl template is the primary reference)

palette_rationale.accent: The client's own primary brand colour, a soft yellow (#FADB6E), detected from their site. Kept as the button/fill accent.
palette_rationale.on_accent: Navy rather than white. White on #FADB6E measures 1.36:1 and fails even the large-text threshold; the client's own navy measures 10.79:1.
palette_rationale.accent_ink: #FADB6E as foreground text on a light background is unreadable (1.36:1 on white). This darkened amber measures 5.07:1 on white and 4.72:1 on the page background, passing AA for eyebrows, tick marks, stars and chevrons.
palette_rationale.primary: The client's navy (#1E2452), used for dark panels. The brand's light blue (#8DD7F7) was rejected as a panel colour — it cannot carry white text.
palette_rationale.muted: Derived. Not detected on the client's site, which used a pale grey that fails AA against white.

contrast_audit.verdict: All pairs pass WCAG AA at normal text size.

typography.source: Detected on the client's existing site — heading stack Montserrat, body stack Open Sans. Retained as genuine brand tokens.

anti_patterns: No glass morphism or backdrop-blur panels
No rows of outline icons — one icon per section at most
No stock 'handshake' or 'team pointing at a laptop' photography
No randomized section order — owl page composition is fixed
Client-site layout, component styling, spacing and CSS classes were NOT extracted and are NOT referenced. Fonts, colours and logo only.
